content: WalkAmerica is an event that takes place in 1,100 communities across the United States. Each year, approximately 7 million dedicated individuals, including 20,000 corporate and family teams as well as national sponsors, participate in this initiative. Since its inception in 1970, WalkAmerica has raised $7 billion to support the March of Dimes in its mission to ensure that all babies are born healthy and at full term. The funds generated from this event are allocated to research aimed at preventing premature births, birth defects, and infant mortality. In the United States, over half a million babies are born prematurely each year, and more than 120,000 are born with severe birth defects. Seventy-six cents of every dollar raised through WalkAmerica is directly invested in research and programs designed to address and reduce the incidence of premature births, congenital anomalies, and infant mortality.
